SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_reviews,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment_label = 'POSITIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment_label = 'NEGATIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_count,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment_label = 'POSITIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1) AS positive_pct,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment_label = 'NEGATIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 1) AS negative_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN needs_review = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_for_review
FROM processed_reviews;

SELECT topic_name, mention_count, negative_mentions
FROM top_topics
WHERE negative_mentions > 0
ORDER BY negative_mentions DESC, mention_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
